walk.suffix: , mouth closed, no facial animation, no chewing, no talking, eyes still, performing a full walk cycle in place: legs and feet cycling through one complete stride, body bobbing naturally up and down with each step, classic looping sprite walk animation, no horizontal movement of the body, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: walking, mid-stride, one front paw lifted, on all fours

idle.suffix: , mouth closed, no facial animation, no chewing, no talking, eyes still, gentle idle motion: soft breathing, slight sway, a small bob in place, no walking, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: sitting calmly on haunches, relaxed, ears up

run.action: running at a brisk gallop in place
run.suffix: , legs cycling quickly through a full running stride, body low and driving forward, energetic looping run animation, no horizontal movement of the body, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: running fast, mid-stride, legs extended in a gallop, body leaning forward

sleep.suffix: , ribcage rising and falling with each slow breath, one ear flicking now and then, tail tip stirring gently, eyes staying closed throughout, calm looping sleep animation, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: lying down curled up, eyes closed, sleeping

sit.suffix: , seated still with small head movements and gentle breathing, no walking, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: sitting upright on haunches, alert, head up, ears perked

eat.suffix: , head dipping down to nibble then up, small repeating chewing motion, no walking, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: head lowered, eating from the ground

jump.suffix: , springing up off all four legs then landing, one bouncy reaction hop, no horizontal movement, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: leaping up into the air, front legs lifted, mid-jump

play.suffix: , a lively playful bounce with tail wagging, energetic reaction loop, no horizontal movement, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: play bow, chest and front legs lowered flat to the ground, hindquarters raised high, tail up
